description: Registry sizes and repetition counts for EXP-001 (evaluation plan rev 25, 13 Nov 2026).
handle_domain: uniform in [1, r - 2]: Z_p* minus r - 1, which is the Merkle upper sentinel
merkle_depth_note: MerkleRevocation has N + 1 range leaves (gaps between the N handles and the sentinels 0 and r - 1), so merkletreejs builds depth ceil(log2(N + 1)). The two formulas differ only at N = 1 (1 vs 2). Rows record the measured proof length.
